newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Acacia Q3 gold output 71,597 ounces.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Acacia Q3 gold output 71,597 ounces.

text.p: Acacia Resources Ltd said on Wednesday that gold production for the quarter ended September 30 totalled 71,597 ounces, up 11.6 percent from the June 1996 quarter and 26 percent higher than the September 1995 quarter.
During the quarter, the company sold 77,275 ounces at A$565 per ounce, A$77 above the average spot price for the quarter.
Year to date gold production totalled 193,472 ounces.
Acacia said its share of contained gold resources increased 17 percent or 910,000 ounces to 6.18 million ounces during the September quarter.

Acacia has a 1/3 interest in Boddington, 100 percent of Union Reefs and Brocks Creek and 40 percent of Tanami.
